description: Senmu BuildOS is a project coach for AI coding agents: turn ideas into requirements, consistent UI, maintainable code and verifiable releases. Eight skills for Codex, Claude Code and more.

summary.zh: 本版加强普通需求到产品、设计与工程的承接，统一持久 UI 规范入口和旧资料迁移方法，区分“未评估”与“没有 UI”。同时重写产品介绍，让八项能力的理念、做法与结果更容易理解；局部修改继续保持轻量。详见[用户更新日志](RELEASE_NOTES.md)。
summary.en: This version strengthens the handoff from everyday requests to product, design and engineering, standardizes the maintained UI entrypoint and migration of existing guidance, and distinguishes an unassessed UI scope from no UI. The product introduction now explains each skill through its principles, methods and outcomes. Small changes remain lightweight. See [release notes](RELEASE_NOTES.md).
summary.ja: 本版は普段の依頼から Product、Design、Engineering への引継ぎを強化し、継続的な UI の規約入口と既存資料の移行方法を統一します。UI の未評価と UI なしを区別し、8 つの能力の考え方、方法、結果が伝わる製品紹介へ更新しました。小さな変更は引き続き簡潔に進めます。[更新履歴](RELEASE_NOTES.md)をご覧ください。
